tagline.en_US: Beets is a music library manager and not, for the most part, a music player. It does include a simple player plugin and an experimental Web-based player, but it generally leaves actual sound-reproduction to specialized tools.

description.en_US: Beets is a music library manager designed to catalog, manage, and organize audio collections. While it leaves actual sound reproduction primarily to specialized players, it includes an experimental web-based player and a simple player plugin. It also supports various plugins to handle metadata retrieval and file organization.
